name: M17MP
summary: M17MP is a Leadshine economic split magnetic encoder family with an RS485 interface for servo motor feedback. This listing represents the manufacturer’s series, with electrical and mechanical options dependent on the selected configuration.

description.en: M17MP is a Leadshine economic split magnetic encoder family with an RS485 interface for servo motor feedback. This listing represents the manufacturer’s series, with electrical and mechanical options dependent on the selected configuration.

sources.title: 雷赛智能-分体磁电系列
sources.quote: M17MP系列磁编码器有以下特点： 1、RS485接口，双向异步串行通信通讯； 2、双向异步串行通信规则，单圈17位，多圈16位； 3、通信线缆最长可达50m； 4、严苛EMC测试，满足恶劣电磁环境工况； 产品优势
